title: There is no blood glucose data for selecting OTTAI
symptom: User reports no blood glucose data when using Ottai with AndroidAPS 3.3.0-dev-c in China, despite having joined Ottai on September 20. Another user reports that data does not go to AndroidAPS even when using the official Ottai app, and no broadcast intents are sent.
cause: The Ottai app (com.ottai.seas) does not send the expected broadcast intents (info.nightscout.androidaps.action.OTTAI_APP or info.nightscout.androidaps.action.SYAI_TAG_APP) to AndroidAPS, as observed by a user who set breakpoints and registered listeners.
evidence_quote: when new data appears in Ottai, your @ottai-developer application does not send a broadcast implicit intent to the system "info.nightscout.androidaps.action.OTTAI_APP" or "info.nightscout.androidaps.action.SYAI_TAG_APP"
